resources.string: YouTube Music through a connector plugin, an app installed separately that implements Songport\'s open connector interface. Songport does not include, download or install plugins; it uses one only if you already have it.
This service needs a connector plugin app that is not installed. Songport does not include or download plugins.
The connector plugin is not installed.
Amazon Music through a connector plugin, an app installed separately that implements Songport\'s open connector interface. Playlists, search, create, add and remove are supported by the plugin.
This service needs a connector plugin app that is not installed. Songport does not include or download plugins.
Spotify through a connector plugin that holds the Spotify sign-in; an alternative to the official route with your own developer key, which stays available as \"Spotify\".
Apple Music through a connector plugin that holds the Apple ID sign-in; an alternative to the official route with your own developer token, which stays available as \"Apple Music\".
This service needs a connector plugin app that is not installed. Songport does not include or download plugins.
